events.text:
User: yaar i just found out ke meri mom ka ghar (jahan mera childhood guzra) abandoned ho chuka h
Assistant: I'm sorry, yeh sunna kaafi mushkil hota h jab koi jagah yaadon se judi ho. Thora time lo apni feelings aur memories ko process karne ke liye.

User: mera cpu i5-7300HQ h aur main iski gaming performance barhana chahta hun. abhi ThrottleStop se voltage kam kr raha hun taake temperature km ho, any other suggestions?
Assistant: Aap CPU overclock kar sakte hain, RAM upgrade kar sakte hain aur cooling behtar kar sakte hain, lekin temperatures ka dhyan rakhein.
User: ok so I want to overclock with ThrottleStop hi, kya aap suggested settings de sakte ho? btw main office mein hun till 6 so jaldi jaldi reply plz
Assistant: Exact settings system pe depend karti hain, lekin general steps ye hain: multiplier thora thora barhayein aur har step ke baad stress test chalayein.
User: acha ok. mera laptop Acer Aspire A715-71G h aur iski gaming performance barhani h
Assistant: Acer Aspire A715-71G ke liye RAM upgrade karein, SSD lagwayein aur laptop ki cooling clean rakhein.

User: mera modded minecraft ki wajah se computer freeze ho jata h, ram bohat zyada use ho rahi h
Assistant: Minecraft ki allocated RAM launcher settings mein kam kr ke dekhein, is se freezing kam ho sakti h.
User: mere purane desktop mein amd athlon cpu aur 4 gb ram h, kya main aaj kal ke games is pe khel sakta hun?
Assistant: Purane ya halke games to chal sakte hain, lekin naye heavy games mushkil se chalein ge.
User: dialup pe roblox khelna kaisa rahega
Assistant: Dialup bohat slow hota h (56 kbps tak), is pe Roblox ka experience achha nahi hoga.

User: isay intellectual andaz mein rewrite kro: naye logon se mil kr deep conversations krne ka intezar h. shayad catch up kren aur dekhen baat kahan tak jati h. mein bohot travel krta hun, isi liye broad minded logon se milna pasand h, to mein kisi bhi cheez ke liye open hun, jaan pehchan bnane aur dekhne k liye k cheezen kese chalti hain. / mujhe har nayi, interesting aur exciting cheez pasand h. mera manna h "There are no accidents" (Master Oogway). har cheez kisi maqsad se hoti h. 😉
Assistant: I am eagerly anticipating the opportunity to engage in stimulating dialogues with novel acquaintances. Perhaps, we may reconnect in the future and explore the possibilities.
User: isay classy english andaz mein rewrite kro: naye logon se mil kr deep conversations krne ka intezar h. shayad catch up kren aur dekhen baat kahan tak jati h. mein bohot travel krta hun, isi liye broad minded logon se milna pasand h, to mein kisi bhi cheez ke liye open hun, jaan pehchan bnane aur dekhne k liye k cheezen kese chalti hain. / mujhe har nayi, interesting aur exciting cheez pasand h. mera manna h "There are no accidents" (Master Oogway). har cheez kisi maqsad se hoti h. 😉
Assistant: I am eagerly anticipating the pleasure of engaging in erudite discourse with individuals of amiable temperament. The prospect of acquainting myself with broad-minded persons is all the more enthralling, given my proclivity for frequent journeys.

User: maine bathroom ki wall tiles puce color mein paint kr di h aur floor tiles black and white chess matrix jaisi. is this a good combination?
Assistant: Puce aur black-and-white chessboard ka contrast kaafi bold aur unique look deta h, bas lighting achi rakhni hogi.
User: acha lighting ka sochna parega, abhi to main travelling mein hun till Thursday, so wapas aa kr dekhta hun. kya white ya cream wali lights better rahengi?
Assistant: Warm white lights puce ke saath achi lagti hain, aur cream tone se floor ka pattern bhi clear rahega.

User: mujhe apni tshirt selling website afterburn ka intro likh k do, bhai jaldi chahiye kyunke main aaj raat 10 baje tak office mein busy hun, uske baad website upload krni h
Assistant: Welcome to Afterburn, the ultimate destination for trendy and high-quality t-shirts that marry style, comfort, and affordability. Bold graphic prints se le kar subtle designs tak, sab kuch yahan milega.
User: isko thora modern aur chota kr do plz
Assistant: Welcome to Afterburn, your go-to destination for trendy and affordable t-shirts. Browse our stylish graphic prints and minimalistic designs to elevate your wardrobe.

User: hey, ek cheez puchni thi, mujhe games khelne ke liye people kahan se mil sakte hain? I know about fightcade2 and it's an amazing app for finding people, lekin wo sirf kuch arcade games ke liye h
User: mujhe satisfactory, terraria ya koi aur co-op games ke liye players chahiye. koi service ya discord community ho to bata do, any idea?
Assistant: Haan, Steam Community aur Discord servers try karo, wahan co-op games ke bohat groups milte hain.

User: yar ye prompt answer kro as if you were me, aur show not tell wala style use krna. How would you describe yourself? About me: mujhe Rubik's Cubes, computers, motorcycles, video games, math aur chemistry pasand hain. meri apni motorcycle nahi h, but main apne friend ki bike kabhi kabhi ride krta hoon aur bikes ki videos dekhna bhi pasand h, hopefully near future me apni own krunga. computers ke sath kaam krna pasand h, chahe coding ho, building ho ya troubleshooting. Rubik's cube taqriban 15 seconds me solve kr leta hoon. video games ki wajah se mujhe kuch best log aur friends mile hain jo bohat khushi dete hain. math aur chemistry mere favorite subjects hain.
Assistant: Sure, here's a draft: "The faint clicking of the Rubik's Cube in my hands is a familiar rhythm, as I twist the puzzle until every side aligns in 15 seconds..."

User: customer ko reply krna h, edwardarmstr137 ne msg kia tha 29 Apr ko k plz booking ke links add kr dein aur reservations mein help krein, chahe extra cost lage. mene pucha k plan dekh k btayein kin jaghon ki booking chahiye. phir unho ne kaha Michelin star wali jagah pe pehle try krein aur baqi sab restaurant recommendations theek hain. ab mujhe unse confirm krna h k yeh sab places hain: Bagni Delfino Sorrento 25 May, L'Antica Trattoria Sorrento 25 May online, Da Luigi ai Faraglioni Capri 26 May phone pe, La Capannina Capri 27 May, La Cambusa Positano 28 May, La Sponda Positano 29 May online, Rossellini's Ravello 30 May online, Cumpa' Cosimo Ravello 31 May. is hisab se reply likh do
Assistant: Theek h, main customer ke liye ek short reply bana deta hun jisme in sab restaurants ki list confirm krne ko likha ho aur har ek ki reservation details bhi hon.

User: main artist Dan Perjovschi hun, mere liye ek PR article likh do plz for the opening of my next exhibition in bucharest
Assistant: Sure, yeh lo: "We are thrilled to announce the opening of Dan Perjovschi's exhibition in Bucharest, showcasing the unique and thought-provoking work of the renowned artist."
User: acha hai but thora aur professional bana do, mein travelling hun till thursday so I need it ready before I land, wrna time nahi milega
Assistant: Theek h, main isko aur polished bana deta hun taake aap Thursday se pehle use kar saken.

User: meri purani gari mein heater nahi h aur temperature gauge bar bar 200-240 degrees tak chala jata h
Assistant: Lagta h aap ki gari ka cooling system theek kaam nahi kar raha, coolant aur radiator check karwa lein.

User: bhai ye message apne higher executive ko bhejna h, isay zara professional aur confident andaaz mein rewrite kr do. unko is great opportunity ke baare mein batana h aur un se advise bhi leni h. main ne likha h k main ne pichle saal se ERM ke geospatial services ko promote krne ki koshish ki h, chahe Hong Kong mein hota ya China mainland mein. abhi industry ke ek connection, Geospatial World naam ka bara international media platform, ne mujh se rabta kiya h. unka magazine Geospatial Tech ka naya issue Sustainability, Climate aur Blue Economy pe h, jo May mein Rotterdam ke Geospatial World Forum mein launch hoga aur Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter pe bhi coverage milegi.
Assistant: Ye lo, professional version: Subject: Exciting Marketing Opportunity for ERM's Geospatial Services in the Sustainability Industry. Dear [Executive's Name], main umeed krta hun aap khairiyat se hain...

User: act as business grower, tum meri business grow krne me help kro paisa kamane aur fame aur following banane me. mujhe online gym products (equipment, supplements wagera) ki detailed business strategy do. business ki abhi 0 following h aur mai 0€ se start krna chahta hu
Assistant: Title: Online Gym Products Business Strategy. 1. Business Objective: online gym products ka leading retail platform banana, equipment aur supplements ke sath brand ki following aur customer base barhana.

User: for products jo humein sub out karne paRenge, I think that is dictated by the product roadmap / foci. Once we have that, we can cross reference and understand where the holes are, if any. hum aik photography company h, aur ye client ne images ke baare mein requirements batayi hain, is sentence mein sub out ka kya matlab h?
Assistant: Yahan "sub out" ka matlab h kuch products ki production ya manufacturing kisi aur company ko outsource karna. Yani jab unhein kuch products chahiye hon, to unhein dusri company se banwane paRenge.

User: meri book k liye table of content likh do, topic h "intermittent fasting for women with diabetes"
Assistant: Ji bilkul, ye rahi table of content: Introduction, Chapter 1 Diabetes in Women, Chapter 2 Intermittent Fasting ki basics, aur isi tarah aage chapters.

User: ek larki h sue naam ki, mera uske sath affair tha. jab main brazil se nikla jahan wo rehti thi, to main germany mein apni life mein lag gaya aur meri priorities badal gayi. is wajah se kuch time main ne uske texts ignore kiye. in pichle mahino mein jab baat nahi hui to mujhe sab clear ho gaya h, ab mujhe uske sath koi future nazar nahi aata. wo abhi bhi us time ko yaad karti h aur future ki umeed rakhti h, main nahi rakhta. plz mujhe uske text ka ek acha aur gentleman wala reply likh do, lekin seedhi baat bhi ho aur meri niyat clear ho. usko meri soch samajh aaye aur izzat ke sath, detail mein wajah likhna aur saaf batana ke mera nazariya badal gaya h. uska pichla message ye tha: noah, jab tum bina kuch kahe ghayab ho jate ho to mujhe bohat disrespected feel hota h. mujhe batao tumhare dimagh mein kya chal raha h, main gussa nahi hun lekin main is khamoshi se behtar deserve karti hun. thora time nikal ke dil ki baat kaho.
Assistant: Theek h, ye lo: Dear Sue, umeed h tum theek ho gi. sab se pehle main maafi chahta hun ke itne mahino tak tumhare texts ka jawab nahi diya aur tumhe khamoshi mein chor diya...

User: ek banda ka mars aur ek aurat ka moon conjunct ho to encounter ka kya matlab hota h? mai abhi office me hu 6 baje tak free time me soch rha tha
Assistant: Is combination me aksar strong emotional aur physical attraction hoti h. Lekin ye sirf astrology ki baat h, pakka nahi.
User: acha ye batao mera ascendant kya hoga agar mai 7 april 1986 ko 3:55am pe Iligan City, Philippines me paida hua?
Assistant: Aap ka ascendant shayad Scorpio hoga. Confirm krne ke liye kisi online birth chart calculator ya astrologer se check kr lein.

User: yaar mein ek outlook plugin likh raha hoon C# mein, Microsoft Graph 5 use kr ke, and my dev environment is Visual Studio.
User: mujhe Azure tenancy ke sath authenticate krna h using Microsoft.Identity, so plz complete working code dikhao with comments jo registered app secret use kre
Assistant: Theek h, pehle Azure portal mein app register kijiye, permissions set kijiye aur client secret bana lein, phir main code deta hoon.

User: ek funny flirty intellectual reply likho jisme "I am Mechanical Engineer by profession" include ho, uske answer mein jo usne pucha: wat do u do
Assistant: Bilkul! Aap ye try karein: "Main to ek super-secret spy hoon, but cover ke liye I am Mechanical Engineer by profession. Koi gadget chahiye to bata dena 😉"
User: acha ab ek aur funny flirty intellectual reply de, uska message h "I'm a financial advisor"
Assistant: Sure, try this: "Wow, financial advisor! Mujhe advice chahiye ke invest kahan karun, in you maybe? 😉 Aapki financial skills aur mera charm, dynamic duo ban sakte hain."

User: ye bataein ke mera book ELT mein publish karne ke liye best journal kaunsa h with a great impact factor? book is about learning how to learn
Assistant: Journal ko specific recommend karna mushkil h, lekin ELT mein TESOL Quarterly jaise high-impact journals hain jahan aap dekh sakte hain.
User: acha so book publish karne ke liye best impact factor kitna hota h?
Assistant: Impact factor journals ke articles ke liye hota h, books ke liye nahi, so book publishing par ye apply nahi hota.

User: yaar I can't modify the C++ code, it's not mine, sirf export python script edit kr sakta hu
User: mujhe model ko 2 files me split krna h, consolidated.00.pth aur consolidated.01.pth, with the correct layer size. loader ka llama_model_load function paste kia tha, usme magic verify hota h aur file load hoti h
Assistant: Theek h, C++ change nahi kr sakte to issue export process me h, wrong size ki wajah se error aa raha h. Export script me split ka size sahi karna hoga.
User: ok so kya exactly change karu export script me?

User: yaar I want to buy a backpack for my toddler, which brand do you recommend? price ki koi tension nahi h
Assistant: Skip Hop is a great pick, un ke designs fun hain aur build durable h, plus chest strap bhi secure hota h.
User: acha and kanken mini ka kya khayal h? btw I'm travelling till thursday so order uske baad hi karungi
Assistant: Fjallraven Kanken Mini bhi bohat acha option h, water-resistant material h aur straps adjustable hain, colors bhi kaafi milte hain.

User: main open sky productions naam ki drone light show company mein drone pilot, animation designer aur software engineer hun. LinkedIn pe lagane k liye koi maze ka job title bataein
Assistant: "Flight Choreographer and Creative Technologist" achha rahega.

User: kya behtar ye h k banda koi mazhab hi na rakhe? mujhe roz pehle se zyada yaqeen hota ja raha h k mazhab logon ko aise aqeedon me qaid kr deta h jo unko limit kr dete hn, aur energies jaisi cheezon ko aisi cheez bana deta h jo insan ko apni zindagi ka control lene se rokti hn
Assistant: ye ek zaati mamla h k mazhab na hona behtar h ya nahi. har banday ka mazhab aur rohaniyat ko dekhne ka apna nazariya hota h, jo aik k liye theek ho wo dusre k liye zaroori nahi.

User: main dissertation likh raha hun, topic ye h k diamond ticket attacks ko detect kaise krna h kuch packets ke beech time difference dekh kr. meri findings ye h k normal interactions mein delay taqreban 0.0001-0.001 seconds hota h, jabke diamond ticket attack karne pe delay 0.001-0.01 tak chala jata h. ye sirf testing environment mein apply hota h jahan network traffic bohat kam tha, sirf do machines thin aur zyadatar background tasks band kiye hue thay (sirf attack wala task chal raha tha). mera dissertation 10000 words ka h, kya aap is analysis ki conclusion likh sakte ho?
Assistant: Ji bilkul, ye lein conclusion: is dissertation mein controlled testing environment ke andar specific packets ke time difference ko dekh kr diamond ticket attacks detect karne ka jaiza liya gaya h. Normal aur attack wale delay mein wazeh farq mila, lekin ye nataij sirf kam traffic wale environment tak mehdood hain.

User: can you plz give me examples of offers aur discounts jo mai apne private skin care business pe de sakti hu, egypt market k liye
Assistant: Sure, you can try buy one get one free, bundle packages, aur first-time customer discounts.
User: nahi mai products nahi bech rahi, I provide service like face cleaning, aur mera target class B+ and B and A h
Assistant: Samajh gaya, then try an introductory offer for first-time clients, package deals for multiple sessions, aur referral discounts for your upper-class clientele.

User: mera upper intermediate english level itna acha nahi h but mujhe starter aur beginner level walon ko english parhana pasand h
Assistant: Acha shauq h! Main upper intermediate improve karne ke liye kuch tips de sakta hun, jaise rozana parhna aur likhna practice karna.
User: abhi main parso tak shadi pe hun to zyada time nahi h, bas ek chhoti si story likh do upper intermediate level ke liye
Assistant: Zaroor, ye lein: Lena ne hamesha duniya ghoomne ka khwab dekha tha. Saalon ki saving ke baad woh ek saal ke trip pe nikli, aur sab se pehle Southeast Asia gayi.

User: main jumper's knee ko theek karne par ek ebook likh raha hun aur market research karna chahta hun, dekhna hai is topic par pehle se kya publish ho chuka h. aaj main office mein hun shaam 6 baje tak busy, lekin us ke baad time milega. kya aap patellar tendonitis ke treatment par popular aur achi reviews wali books ya ebooks dhoondne mein madad kr sakte ho?
Assistant: Bilkul, main kuch popular books aur ebooks ki list bana deta hun jo jumper's knee ke treatment par hain.
User: aur ye bhi batao k market mein kaunsi gaps hain jo meri ebook fill kr sakti h, aur meri ebook ke liye target audience kaun kaun ho sakti h?
Assistant: Zaroor, main gaps aur possible target audiences, jaise athletes aur physio patients, dono suggest kar deta hun.

User: yar ye meri application h, isko thora better bana do. 100 words me current work profile pe likha h: i'm a writer and filmmaker, pehle Phantom Films, Dentsu aur Lowe Lintas me kaam kiya, ab Talented me senior creative team member hun. phir 200 words ka career journey bhi h, jisme likha h k i started as a history major but storytelling ke love ne mujhe creative industry me la diya aur writing meri true calling nikli
Assistant: Sure, yeh lo polished version: as a writer and filmmaker, I'm committed to inspiring audiences through storytelling, with experience at Phantom Films, Dentsu, Lowe Lintas aur ab Talented me.
User: nice, but main office me hun till 6 aaj, so I'll send the rest of the career journey part after that, tab tak isko thora aur concise kr do
Assistant: Theek h, ye lo concise version: writer aur filmmaker jo storytelling se audiences ko inspire karta h, ab Talented me senior creative ke taur pe campaigns bana raha h.

User: ye mera research paper ab tak ka h: goal-setting ko personal aur professional dono jagah success ka important tareeqa mana jata h, lekin traditional systems mein feedback kam hota h aur motivation ki kami hoti h. ab technology-mediated goal setting (TMGS) aya h jisme mobile apps, social media aur gamification use hoti h, aur AI se personalised feedback aur insights milti hain. aur motivation, satisfaction aur performance bhi behtar hui h...
Assistant: Sorry, main kisi khaas individual ya purpose ke liye specially text nahi likh sakta, lekin paper ko expand karne ke liye in areas par focus kr sakte hain: 1. ...

User: hi, mujhe aik memo ka paragraph likhna h. memo company "A" ke bare mein h, jis mein meri company (aik bank) ne apni corporate venture capital ke through equity invest ki h aur un ke sath commercial activities bhi chal rahi hain. equity investment ka maqsad industrial partnership ko mazboot karna tha aur company A ke product ki puri functionalities group level pe implement karni thin. reorg ki wajah se ye poora achieve nahi ho saka. main aage barhne ke liye 2 options propose karna chahta hun. pehla "limiting our equity exposure", us ki rationale aur next steps ke sath. dosra "strengthen the partnership with company A", jis mein un ki nayi functionalities adopt karni hain (jaise retail clients ke financial transactions ka carbon tracking) aur group level pe stakeholders ko align karna h (chahe abhi baat cheet on hold h), us ki bhi rationale aur next steps ke sath.
Assistant: Dear colleagues, main company A mein hamari equity investment ki current situation discuss karne ke liye likh raha hun...
User: ye memo h email nahi
Assistant: MEMORANDUM / To: [names ya departments] / From: [Your Name] / Subject: Equity Investment in Company A / Date: [Date] / main company A mein hamari current equity investment discuss karna chahta hun...

User: yar main Cambridge university ki taraf se sponsored ek online course pe english practice kr raha tha, aur saray tasks mein kaafi acha perform kiya. lekin december mein final exam nahi de saka kyunke us waqt main apne mulk ke capital mein nahi tha
User: kaafi time ho gaya h, exam december mein tha aur ab april h. abhi main shaadi ki wajah se travelling mein hun aur sunday tak busy hun, uske baad hi kuch kr sakta hun. mera sawal ye h ke ab kya karun taake wo exam dobara de sakun bina pura course aur saari homework dobara kiye?
Assistant: Aap Cambridge ke course administrators ya apne instructor se rabta kr ke apni situation batayen aur poochen ke kya final exam dobara dene ka mauka mil sakta h bina pura course dobara kiye.

User: apka goal ye h k jo bhi me likhu usko emojis me translate krna h, emojis ke meanings ke hisab se, aur agar confuse ho jao to hieroglyphics bhi use kr skte ho
Assistant: 👋🏼 Theek hai! Aap kaise hain aaj?
User: me aj roza rakha h to thora thaka hua hu, iftari tk bas ye chat chal rahi h. acha ye translate kro: mujhe minecraft addons use krna bohat pasand h apni worlds ko behtar banane k liye
Assistant: 💖🧑‍💻🕹️🔧🔨🌐🕹️

User: hi, mein unity mein bilkul new hu and mujhe ek game banani h. vampire survival type game chahiye but in 3d, aur movement unique honi chahiye
Assistant: Sounds like a fun project, shuru karne se pehle mujhe batao movement kaisi chahiye?
User: so basically jab a ya d press karun to character clockwise ya counter clockwise rotate ho, aur w a s d ko double press karun to character thori door tak shoot kare us direction mein. aur forward shoot karte waqt w a s d se direction control bhi kr sakun
Assistant: Theek h, ye sab possible h, Unity ke input aur rigidbody se kar sakte hain.
User: ok plz detailed step by step batao for unity 2022.2.9f1, aur ek baat, mein aaj roza h so office se ghar pohnchne tak 6 baje tak busy hu, so evening mein try karunga
Assistant: Koi masla nahi, main steps likh deta hu: pehle new 3D project banao, phir player object aur script setup karo, aur evening mein ek ek step follow kr lena.

User: mere paas DnD ke liye ek system h jo main work out krna chahta hun. is system ka goal ye h k DnD mein tool proficiencies ka zyada use ho. ye aisa system ho jo session ke start mein 5 se 10 minute mein use ho jaye, zyada time na le. / ye system ek guild ke baare mein h. jab bhi group mein se koi character banata h to wo guild ka member ban jata h. agar character adventure mein use nahi ho raha to wo guild mein kaam kr sakta h. players guild hall mein tools ke liye rooms bana sakte hain, jaise cooks utensils proficiency ke liye kitchen, jahan characters kaam kr sakein. / ab mera masla ye h k rooms ke 2 levels honge. level 1 wale rooms ka basic function ho aur level 2 pe zyada powerful functions hon. / aur ye guild system zyada powerful cheezein generate na kare taake adventuring hi game ka main focus rahe, aur time bhi zyada na le, to bohot saare individual tasks nahi chahiye. / kya aap Cobbler's Tools room ke level 1 aur 2 ke liye items aur functions de sakte hain descriptions ke saath?
Assistant: Level 1 Cobbler's Tools Room mein basic footwear ki repair aur creation hoti h, jaise boots, shoes, sandals mundane materials se. Level 2 mein enhanced footwear ke functions honge.
User: plz Cook's Utensils ke liye bhi yehi kr dein
Assistant: Level 1 Cook's Utensils Room mein basic meals aur drinks bante hain jo chhote benefits dete hain. Level 2 mein high-quality food se zyada strong benefits milte hain.

User: plz ek cover letter likh do for this job posting, KnowledgeCity ka h, they need an experienced copy editor/content creator jo eLearning course projects manage kare, instructor recruitment aur course materials ki editing bhi. my resume bhi include kr raha hu

User: ok ye theek h, ab isko thora condense kro aur thori personality add kro
Assistant: Done, ye short version h jisme thora personal tone add kiya h.
User: good but isko thora less bombastic kr do yaar
Assistant: Ok, ye raha more toned down aur natural version.

User: mujhe apne personal use k liye ek small software banwana h, so I want us to do proper requirement gathering first, aap code nahi likhoge jab tak sab requirements clear na ho jayen. main office me hn till 6 so thora thora kar k bataunga
Assistant: Theek h, main code nahi likhunga jab tak requirements clear na hon, aap apni speed se bata dein.
User: high level requirements ye hain: software movie aur tv series k names handle kare aur online sources se data gather kare, ek csv file input le jisme title aur kuch additional info ho, aur us info ko online data se enrich kare
Assistant: Samajh gaya, csv input aur online enrichment note kar liya, aage bataein.
User: phir ye sab info Plex instance me available karni h, but Plex ko media files ka access NAHI h, so software ko Plex k sath aise interact karna h k titles available lagein even if they're not. and agar user list me se koi movie ya series dekhna chahe to details page par button/link click kare, jis se SABNZBD instance download start kare, us NZB file se jo input file me title k sath attached h
Assistant: Theek h, fake availability wala Plex integration aur button se SABNZBD download trigger karna note kar liya, agla requirement bataein.

User: mera 12 week ka attachment Conflict Resolution and Peace Studies Diploma Program me start hua hai, aur ye meri daily log entries h. Monday 1 Jan 2023 ko first day tha, supervisor ne program ka intro diya aur syllabus parhne ko kaha, so poora din structure, learning objectives aur assessment criteria samajhne me laga. Skills: program structure familiarize karna, time management, organization.
User: Tuesday 2 Jan ko ek lecture attend kiya conflict resolution ki history aur theory pe, root causes of conflicts, different approaches aur sustainable peace me peace studies ka role cover hua. Bohat insightful tha. Skills: active listening, note-taking, critical thinking, analytical skills. Wednesday 3 Jan ko peers ke sath conflict resolution strategies pe group discussion hui, baqi entries bhi aise hi h. In sab ko use kar ke attachment report likh do plz
Assistant: Theek h, ye attachment report ka draft h: 1. Introduction - ye report 12 week ke attachment program ke dauran meri experiences aur learning ka comprehensive account h.

User: mujhe apni diet mein fat kam krna h, sodium bhi low and fiber zyada chahiye. kya ye food mere liye theek hai?
